centers=[21,26,31,36,41]
def caps():
    r=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[42]
    return tuple('B' if r[c]=='B' else 'w' for c in centers)

    c=caps()
    return [centers[i] for i in range(5) if c[i]!=tgt[i]]
def done(res):
    return bool(res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('run_complete'))

if done(last_action_result):
    print("LEVEL COMPLETE at t2"); result='done@t2'
else:
    t1=('w','B','B','B','w')
    cl2=clicks_to(t1)
    print("step2 clicks:",cl2,"-> expect",t1)
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':c} for c in cl2])
    print("now:",caps(),"res:",{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete','board_changed']})
    if done(last_action_result):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETE at t1"); result='done@t1'
    else:
        print("both static configs failed"); result='static_exhausted'
